model.architecture: decoder-only, SwiGLU, mlp_ratio 8, RoPE, RMSNorm with affine eps 1e-6, no biases, untied embeddings, init normal std 0.02 truncated at 3 std

decontamination.rule: before tokenization, every training document whose SHA-256 of NFC-normalized text equals a sha256_nfc in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl is removed (scripts/decontaminate.py), and the matched evaluation ids are reported per corpus

eval.definition: c4_en_bits_per_token: mean next-token cross-entropy on held-out C4-en validation, in nats divided by ln 2, at the final checkpoint
eval.file: DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file: OLMo eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy (https://olmo-data.org/eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy, sha256 c37d6b115de9120bfaefe9ca6a20a310eb6738c20bc26abf469dcada66100ab4) with its part-0-00000.csv.gz metadata; 2,099 documents, 1,021,899 tokens, listed by id and text hash in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl
